hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */frontend/src/*.ts|*/frontend/src/*.tsx) rel="${f#*/frontend/}"; out=$(cd frontend && pnpm exec eslint "$rel" 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then msg=$(printf '%s' "$out" | jq -Rs .); printf '{"systemMessage":"SEC-009/lint violation in %s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":%s}}' "$rel" "$msg"; fi ;; esac; }
hooks.statusMessage: Checking SEC-009 / boundary lint rules on edited file...

hooks.command: out=$(cd frontend && pnpm lint 2>&1 && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then reason=$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -c 3000 | jq -Rs .); printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":%s}}' "$reason"; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Running lint + typecheck before push (mirrors CI)...
